description: This file defines an abstract class 'ContentPage' which extends 'SimplePage'. It manages content rendering for pages, including configurations, content types, and associated files in a documentation or content management system. The class provides methods for setting/getting file info, content type, configuration, and generating page content from files.

classes.name: ContentPage
classes.description: An abstract base class for content pages, handling content rendering with support for configuration, content type, and file association.

methods.name: ContentPage
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the page with a title and content.

methods.name: setParams
methods.description: Deprecated method to set the configuration; now redirects to setConfig().

methods.name: setContentType
methods.description: Sets the content type for the page.

methods.name: getPureContent
methods.description: Generates and returns the page content in its final form.

methods.name: generatePage
methods.description: Returns the rendered content of the page.

methods.name: fromFile
methods.description: Creates a new instance of ContentPage (or subclass) from a file, configuration, and content type.
